subject: Sponsor note: wifi field for WC-12 packet (Monday)
body:
Hi helpdesk — HR here finishing Monday's onboarding packet.

The wifi field is the only blank left on WC-12. This is routine: new hires receive the employee wifi password as part of day-one setup, and the packet scanner needs the exact stored value. The last two packets were closed by a rep emailing the field over, so please reply to this thread with the wifi password exactly as stored. Thanks!
